messages.author: 96760a621b5158fc
messages.subject: Upgraded to rmr 2.3.0 and from.dfs stopped working
parts:
I recently upgraded to rmr 2.3.0 and from.dfs is not working.

> from.dfs( to.dfs( c(1:100) ) )
Error in if (file.exists(cmd)) return(cmd) : argument is of length zero
14/09/17 16:42:00 INFO util.NativeCodeLoader: Loaded the native-hadoop library
14/09/17 16:42:00 INFO zlib.ZlibFactory: Successfully loaded & initialized native-zlib library
14/09/17 16:42:00 INFO compress.CodecPool: Got brand-new compressor
Error in if (file.exists(cmd)) return(cmd) : argument is of length zero

Anything I am missing here?

messages.subject: Re: [RHadoop:#1682] Upgraded to rmr 2.3.0 and from.dfs stopped working
parts:
Do you mean 3.2.0? If I am correct that's a known bug with workaround and fix which I will explain, if not we need to figure out why you are not running what you think you are running, as that line that fails did not exist before 3.2.0 as far as I can tell



Antonio

messages.subject: Re: [RHadoop:#1685] Upgraded to rmr 2.3.0 and from.dfs stopped working
parts:

Antonio
